name: Block
description: The smallest still life: a 2x2 square that never changes.

name: Beehive
description: A six-cell still life, the second most common in random soups.

name: Blinker
description: Three cells in a row flipping between horizontal and vertical.

name: Toad
description: Two offset rows of three cells, oscillating with period 2.

name: Beacon
description: Two diagonal blocks whose touching corners blink on and off.

name: Pulsar
description: A 48-cell period-3 oscillator with four-fold symmetry, the most common period-3 oscillator.

name: Glider
description: The smallest spaceship: it moves one cell diagonally every four generations.

name: Lightweight spaceship
description: A 9-cell spaceship moving two cells horizontally every four generations.

name: R-pentomino
description: Five cells that evolve chaotically for 1103 generations before stabilising.

name: Acorn
description: Seven cells that take 5206 generations to stabilise.

name: Diehard
description: Seven cells that vanish completely after 130 generations.

name: Gosper glider gun
description: The first known finite pattern with unbounded growth: it emits a glider every 30 generations.
